career_ladder.note: Specialist Officers (Scale I) in Public Sector Banks serve in technical, legal, agricultural, IT, HR, and marketing verticals. As specialist domain leaders, officers manage corporate networks, farm credit schemes, statutory compliance, litigation, and branding across branches, zonal offices, and corporate headquarters.

exam_scheme.note: The IBPS CRP for Specialist Officers (CRP SPL) follows a Three-Tier Selection Architecture: Preliminary Examination (Screening), Main Examination (Professional Knowledge evaluation in the relevant discipline), and Personal Interview conducted by participating public sector banks. Objective tests carry negative marking of 1/4th (0.25 marks) per incorrect response.

financial_package.pay_source_label: 12th Bipartite Settlement & Joint Note on Bank Officer Salaries (IBA), JMGS-I entry basic ₹48,480
financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹48,480 per the 12th Bipartite Settlement. Allowances include Dearness Allowance, Special Allowance (with DA thereon), Learning Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, and Bank leased accommodation or House Rent Allowance (ranging from 7% to 10% depending on city classification). Deductions comprise NPS contribution (10%) and applicable taxes.
official_perks: Bank leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance in major centers
Special Allowance, Location Allowance, and Learning Allowance per Bipartite settlement
Concessional interest rate staff loans for housing, car, and personal needs
Comprehensive medical assistance and family hospitalization insurance
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Home Town travel once in two years with leave encashment
Reimbursement of monthly conveyance / petrol, newspaper, and mobile bill expenses

competition_benchmarks.note: IBPS Specialist Officers recruitment selects specialized domain graduates across 11 public sector banks for IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer, Rajbhasha Adhikari, Law Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer cadres.
